summary_en: This study tests NovoTTF-200T(P), a device also called TTFields in the summary, combined with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel before surgery. It is for resectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine are given by IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of 28-day cycles for 3 cycles, and the device is worn more than 18 hours a day from cycle 1 day 1 through cycle 3. If stable disease or better, surgery follows, and if the result is R0 or R1, 3 more cycles are given. This is a Phase 2 study; the record mentions two co-primary endpoints without naming them, and secondary measures include overall response rate (ORR), adverse events, and overall survival (OS).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa NovoTTF-200T(P), un dispositivo también llamado TTFields en el resumen, combinado con gemcitabina y nab-paclitaxel antes de la cirugía. Va dirigido al adenocarcinoma de páncreas resecable. El nab-paclitaxel y la gemcitabina se administran por vía intravenosa los días 1, 8 y 15 de ciclos de 28 días, durante 3 ciclos, y el dispositivo se usa más de 18 horas al día desde el día 1 del ciclo 1 hasta el ciclo 3. Si la enfermedad está estable o mejor, se realiza la cirugía, y si el resultado es R0 o R1, se dan 3 ciclos más. Es un estudio de Fase 2; el registro menciona dos criterios principales co-primarios sin nombrarlos, e incluye como medidas secundarias la tasa de respuesta global (ORR), los eventos adversos y la supervivencia global (OS).
who_for: Age 18 or older, with Karnofsky performance status of 70% or higher.
Pathology-confirmed pancreatic adenocarcinoma with a resectable primary tumor on imaging.
No prior surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, targeted or investigational therapy for pancreatic cancer.
Adequate blood counts, kidney function, and liver function.
not_for: Electrical implanted device in the torso, such as a pacemaker or defibrillator.
Significant uncontrolled heart disease or symptomatic arrhythmia.
Known allergy to medical adhesives or conductive hydrogel.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or another malignancy that could interfere with the study.
